      <div style="font-weight: bold;">Employee Frequently Asked Questions</div>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <table style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;" class="DSPFListTable" id="zf965a4ed7aaf4bb3a64b9c1aa07e0043" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right; font-weight: bold;">1.</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div style="font-weight: bold;">What was announced?</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <table style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;" class="DSPFListTable" id="z3fd239b4c17542679cebc62ed1bbdf81" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 18pt;"><br>
            </td>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right;">&#8226;</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div>We announced that we have entered into a definitive agreement under which Standard Industries Holdings, a privately held global industrial company, will acquire Grace
                for $70 per share in cash. Standard Industries Holdings&#8217; related investment platform 40 North Management LLC is a long-standing shareholder of Grace.</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <table style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;" class="DSPFListTable" id="z572d6f828f6d4a38a2e30d3edd4e8277" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 18pt;"><br>
            </td>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right;">&#8226;</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div>Following the closing of the transaction, Grace will become a privately held company.</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <table style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;" class="DSPFListTable" id="zfe85be2300b44e64aa4e0b015e3e25b7" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 18pt;"><br>
            </td>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right;">&#8226;</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div>Whether we are public or private, we are committed to pursuing our growth plan and delivering value to our customers around the world.</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <table style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;" class="DSPFListTable" id="z6115f12255ff444681a60dd99e9f25bf" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 4.5pt;"><br>
            </td>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right; font-weight: bold;">2.</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div style="font-weight: bold;">What are the benefits of this transaction?</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <table style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;" class="DSPFListTable" id="z5a55558757b9429288cd9ec202976515" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 18pt;"><br>
            </td>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right;">&#8226;</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div>This transaction is about positioning Grace for continued innovation and growth as a private company.</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <table style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;" class="DSPFListTable" id="zf46ce3f5b13047caba1b8cd3be43f4db" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 18pt;"><br>
            </td>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right;">&#8226;</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div>Standard Industries Holdings&#8217; commitment to invest $7 billion in our company is a clear indication of their confidence in our growth opportunities and ability to
                deliver value, and a clear testament to the strengths of our talented employees, industry-leading technologies, and deep global customer relationships.</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <table style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;" class="DSPFListTable" id="z20272bd63c384e75b821cdb57297bc46" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 4.5pt;"><br>
            </td>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right; font-weight: bold;">3.</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div style="font-weight: bold;">What does it mean to be a privately held company?</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <table style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;" class="DSPFListTable" id="z368be205b62f42c69bd8519986118a6d" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 18pt;"><br>
            </td>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right;">&#8226;</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div>By becoming a private company, Grace&#8217;s common stock will no longer be traded on the NYSE.</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <table style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;" class="DSPFListTable" id="zb962b93d26a94676b38c45d4963f13af" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 18pt;"><br>
            </td>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right;">&#8226;</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div>As part of this, we will no longer report quarterly earnings, but, from a day-to-day perspective, most things will continue unchanged, including our focus on our
                customers, our product technology and manufacturing capabilities and our global team.</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <table style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;" class="DSPFListTable" id="z0833fa3acbc14e5193b6001ab2617071" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 18pt;"><br>
            </td>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right;">&#8226;</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div>Until the transaction closes, which we expect to occur in the fourth quarter of 2021, we remain a publicly traded company.</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>
      <div><br>

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right; font-weight: bold;">15.</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div style="font-weight: bold;">What should I do if I&#8217;m contacted by the media, investors or other outside parties?</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>
      <div><br>
      </div>
      <table style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: #000000;" class="DSPFListTable" id="z132026ed43dd4489a4839ebf3294ee2f" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

          <tr>
            <td style="width: 18pt;"><br>
            </td>
            <td style="width: 18pt; vertical-align: top; align: right;">&#8226;</td>
            <td style="width: auto; vertical-align: top;">
              <div>Consistent with company policy, if you receive any inquiries from investors, members of the media, or anyone else, please do not respond. Please forward questions
                investor-related questions to Jason Hershiser at jason.hershiser@grace.com and media-related questions to Caitlin Leopold at Caitlin.leopold@grace.com.</div>
            </td>
          </tr>

      </table>

      </div>

            </td>

              <div>Questions from customers or suppliers should be directed to your GLT member who will guide you on the appropriate response.</div>

      <div><font style="color: #231F20;">This communication relates to the proposed transaction
          involving W. R. Grace &amp; Co. (&#8220;Grace&#8221; or the &#8220;Company&#8221;).&#160; In connection with the proposed transaction, Grace will file relevant materials with the </font>U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;SEC&#8221;)<font style="color: #231F20;">, including Grace&#8217;s proxy statement on Schedule 14A (the &#8220;Proxy Statement&#8221;).&#160; This communication is not a substitute for the Proxy Statement or any other document that Grace may file
          with the SEC or send to its stockholders in connection with the proposed transaction.&#160; BEFORE MAKING ANY VOTING DECISION, STOCKHOLDERS OF GRACE ARE URGED TO READ ALL RELEVANT DOCUMENTS FILED WITH THE SEC, INCLUDING THE PROXY STATEMENT, WHEN THEY
          BECOME AVAILABLE BECAUSE THEY WILL CONTAIN IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT THE PROPOSED TRANSACTION.&#160; Investors and security holders will be able to obtain the documents (when available) free of charge at the SEC&#8217;s website, http://www.sec.gov, and
          Grace&#8217;s website, www.grace.com.&#160; </font>In addition, the documents <font style="color: #231F20;">(when available) may </font>be obtained free of charge by accessing the Investor
        Relations section of Grace&#8217;s website at investor.grace.com or by contacting Grace&#8217;s Investor Relations by email at investor.relations@grace.com<font style="color: #231F20;">.</font></div>
